cad_axes: robot X=-CAD Y, robot Y=CAD X, robot Z=CAD Z
depth_origin: CAD front plate minus 4.3 mm along forward; plus 17.5 mm robot-left to depth imager. Nominal RealSense D435 mechanical offsets.
boundary: Nominal rigid forward-facing CAD mount, not calibrated. Base Z uses CAD assembly origin. Existing LiDAR Z=0 is a legacy planar convention, not physical scan height. Do not use for floor-height filtering until vertical frame convention is reconciled.
